jobs.title: Founding Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role  We are a well-funded, early-stage company building an enterprise context layer that makes AI agents reliable, accurate, and secure for critical business operations in highly regulated industries such as insurance, asset management, banking, healthcare, and logistics. Our platform automatically builds a holistic domain model across enterprise data — mapping relationships, resolving conflicts, and delivering real-time, governed context to AI agents at runtime.  We're looking for a  Founding Cloud Infrastructure Engineer  to design, build, and own the cloud infrastructure powering our semantic platform. This is a  build-from-scratch  role — you won't be maintaining legacy systems. You'll be making foundational architectural decisions that shape the company for years to come.  What You'll Do    Design and build cloud infrastructure from the ground up to power a production-grade semantic AI platform    Own the full lifecycle of infrastructure decisions — from initial architecture through deployment and scaling    Make foundational cloud infrastructure choices with long-term organizational implications    Establish best practices, standards, and tooling in a greenfield environment    Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation systems    Implement infrastructure monitoring, observability, and logging systems    Design and manage database infrastructure across relational and NoSQL systems at scale    Implement infrastructure security, networking, and access control frameworks    What We're Looking For   Required (Dealbreakers):     5+ years designing and operating cloud infrastructure systems in production environments    Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi    Proven experience architecting and managing Kubernetes clusters or container orchestration platforms in production     Required Skills:     Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — including networking, storage, compute, and managed services    Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation    Familiarity with observability and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, ELK stack, Datadog, New Relic)    Experience designing database infrastructure including relational and NoSQL systems at scale    Strong security, networking, and access control implementation background    Comfort operating in early-stage environments — setting standards, not following playbooks     Nice to Have:     Experience building data infrastructure or data pipeline systems    Familiarity with knowledge graphs, semantic systems, or graph databases    Experience with machine learning infrastructure or AI/ML platform systems    Prior founding or early-stage startup experience    Location  This role is based on-site in  San Mateo, CA . Visa sponsorship is  not available  for this position.  Compensation & Benefits  Compensation details were not specified for this role. As a well-funded early-stage company, we offer competitive compensation including equity commensurate with a founding team member's impact and scope. jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role  Join a small, ambitious team building the core software platform that controls and optimises industrial battery storage assets across Europe. As a  Founding Engineer , you will have outsized ownership across the full stack — from real-time optimisation algorithms and backend services to operator-facing dashboards and cloud infrastructure. Your work will directly shape both the product and the trajectory of the company at a critical early stage.  This is an on-site, full-time position based in  Munich, Germany . Visa sponsorship is available.  What You'll Do    Own and build the core product powering real-time optimisation and forecasting for industrial energy assets.    Develop backend services and mixed-integer optimisation algorithms to process high-frequency data in real time.    Design and scale distributed infrastructure to support thousands of battery systems in production.    Build intuitive frontend dashboards that allow battery operators to monitor, control, and analyse their assets.    Implement containerised, CI/CD-driven deployment pipelines and maintain production observability.    Collaborate directly with founders and customers to define product features and translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.    Iterate rapidly based on feedback from live deployments.    What We're Looking For   Required:     Experience with real-time data processing and optimisation or forecasting systems.    Proven ability to design and operate scalable distributed backend systems for large-scale deployments.    Solid Python backend development skills, including mixed-integer optimisation.    Frontend development proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and React (Next.js preferred); experience with Tailwind CSS.    Containerisation and modern deployment practices — Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD for production services.    Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).    Database design and data modelling experience (e.g. PostgreSQL or MySQL).    Cloud infrastructure experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.    Startup experience (company under 3 years old and fewer than 50 employees qualifies).    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Electrical Engineering with a grade better than 2.0 (German grading scale).     Fluency in German  — the majority of customers communicate in German.     Nice to Have:     Background or hands-on experience in the energy industry (battery storage, renewables, grid management, or similar).    Demonstrated track record of deploying optimisations in live production systems.    Compensation & Benefits     Salary:  €70,000 – €100,000 per year, depending on experience.    Founding-stage equity and meaningful ownership in the company's success.    High-impact role with direct influence over product and company direction.    Visa sponsorship available for qualified candidates.    Location  This is a fully  on-site role in Munich, Germany . You will be working day-to-day with a tight-knit founding team in the office.
